text: Remote team handoffs are a constant tug-of-war between convenience and control. When we prioritize speed—a quick Slack message or a vague Loom video—we risk losing vital context and triggering costly rework. Conversely, over-indexing on control through exhaustive documentation and mandatory syncs creates bottlenecks that kill momentum. The goal isn't to pick a side, but to find the sweet spot: a workflow where information flows fast enough to maintain velocity, but clearly enough to preserve quality.
